name: Hallucination Risk Lite API
shortDescription: Score AI-generated text for hallucination risk and unsupported claims
description: Evaluate AI-generated or unverified text for hallucination risk with claim-level confidence scores, hedging detection, and provenance metadata. Built for LLM output validation agents, editorial QA pipelines, and automated fact-checking workflows. Returns a risk level, unsupported claim list, overconfidence signals, and agent-ready recommendations for downstream orchestration.
